text:
Noah (docs): Pushed a tiny PR to clarify autoscale key renames and add a small YAML example for cooldown + isolation labels. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/5201

Priya (eng): Nice. Please map old->new keys: max_nodes -> max_instances, scale_window -> cooldown_seconds, burst_policy -> burst_strategy.

Noah (docs): Done in the PR. Added this YAML snippet:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 4
  cooldown_seconds: 180
  burst_strategy: conservative
labels:
  tenant: regulated
```

Sam (platform): Add a short caveat: when using isolation: strict, pin model-version and avoid shared reserved pools.

Noah (docs): Added a single-line warning and a troubleshooting bullet about preemptions and label checks. Fixed two broken handbook links.

CI Bot: Link-check passed. Docs lint: minor nit (yaml spacing) fixed by author.

Priya (eng): LGTM. Merge when ready.

Noah (docs): Merged and backported to on-prem. Filing onboarding follow-up to add the YAML snippet to quickstart.

Sam (platform): Thanks — closing thread.
